# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

## Markdown and LaTeX Math Rendering Rules
When generating, modifying, or refactoring Markdown (.md) documents within this repository, you must strictly follow these formatting guidelines for mathematical equations to ensure perfect rendering on GitHub:

1. **Inline Math:** Always use a single dollar sign delimiter (`expressionexpressionexpression`). Do NOT use `.........` or `\... \`.
2. **Block Math:** Always use double dollar sign delimiters on their own lines (`expressionexpressionexpression`). Do NOT use `\... \` or `\... \`.
3. **Table Math:** Ensure that any math formulas written inside Markdown tables use standard dollar signs (`.........`) and keep all text readable without extra escaped backslashes.
